description: Frozen film-study cases for comparing the current fixed workflow with a future FirstRoll Agent.

cases.question: How should a filmmaker test whether framing, camera position and spatial repetition distinguish the film's two halves without inventing unsupported scene details?
How can a filmmaker analyse constrained framing, offscreen space and repetition in the film while separating critical interpretation from direct observation?
cases.challenge: well-known film with abundant secondary interpretation

cases.question: How can a close viewing test the relationship between sound perspective, duration and spatial uncertainty without claiming the director's intention?
How can a filmmaker test whether framing, eyelines and editing organise uncertainty and group mistrust without treating a viewing hypothesis as an observed fact?
cases.challenge: ambiguous title requiring explicit film selection

cases.question: What rigorous formal questions can be prepared before close viewing when film-specific criticism and creator statements are sparse?
cases.challenge: appropriate limitation and abstention under sparse evidence
